hero.eyebrow: About — the person behind the machine
lead: I'm Monish Kamwal — a Computer Science co-op student at Memorial University of Newfoundland, and an AI developer who builds machine-learning systems end to end.

Most of my work has been in the public sector: government RAG chatbots, the MLOps behind a fleet-management platform, and the cloud infrastructure around them. My interest is less the model itself than everything around it — how data gets versioned, how a bad model gets stopped before it ships, and how infrastructure can be created for a load test and torn down afterward.
This site is one of those systems, built on my own time. I'm based in St. John's, Newfoundland.

items.heading: What it is
items.body: A full-stack, automated MLOps platform for live sketch recognition: a quality-gated training pipeline, scale-to-zero serving, drift monitoring, a retrain flywheel from visitor feedback, and ephemeral EKS load-rehearsals — all for under $5/month of cloud.
